name: Mixpanel
label: Mixpanel Ingestion + Query + Export APIs
description: Official Mixpanel Ingestion API (api.mixpanel.com), Query API (mixpanel.com/api), and Raw Data Export (data.mixpanel.com). No single version number; Ingestion OpenAPI 1.0.0. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Ingest vs query use different auth: this spec uses HTTP Basic service account (userKey service_account_user + secret service_account_secret) which is required for import/query/export. track/engage officially use project token in event JSON (`$token` / `properties.token` on INPUT); prefer import for server-side events. Default hosts are US; region=eu|in is not interpolated. Customer owns the Mixpanel project. Never log tokens, secrets, or event property values.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example keys match api_spec.json required/queryFrom/bodyFrom.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: track | import | engage.set | engage.unset | export | insights.query | funnel.query.

schema.label: events
schema.description: JSON array of event objects for track / import. A list of JSON object strings is parsed. Official body is that array, not a wrapper. Example: [{"event":"Signup","properties":{"distinct_id":"u1","token":"…"}}].

schema.label: event
schema.description: Single event name for track when events is omitted. Sent with properties and distinct_id as one event. Example: Signup.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: Track properties, or the engage.set map. distinct_id is copied in when missing. engage.unset uses the property names. Import also needs time and $insert_id.

schema.label: distinct_id
schema.description: End-user id for engage.set / engage.unset and optional track. Example: user-42.

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Mixpanel project id for import / export / insights / funnel. Example: 1234567.

schema.label: $distinct_id
schema.description: engage raw $distinct_id when not using distinct_id.

schema.label: $token
schema.description: Project token for engage when not using the service-account project. Never log.

schema.label: $unset
schema.description: engage.unset list of property names. Example: ["plan"].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Size-capped. Never log secrets or raw PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: track | import | engage.set | engage.unset | export | insights.query | funnel.query.

configurationParameters.label: Service account user
configurationParameters.description: Mixpanel service account username. HTTP Basic user. Required for import / query / export.

configurationParameters.label: Service account secret
configurationParameters.description: Mixpanel service account secret (StudioQuack secret). HTTP Basic password. Shown once at creation. Never on INPUT. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Project id
configurationParameters.description: Numeric project id. Query param for import/query/export when INPUT omits it.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: us | eu | in — must match Project Settings → Data Residency. OfficialApiNode paths are US hosts; EU/IN require a host swap the handler cannot do yet.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
